title: Trump’s Push to Defeat Thomas Massie Is the Most Expensive House Primary in Recent Years
key_takeaways: Representative Thomas Massie, a Republican from Kentucky, has been a thorn in the side of the GOP establishment for years.
He has pointed to his strong record of supporting conservative causes and his willingness to stand up to party leadership when necessary.
Regardless of who wins, the primary is likely to have significant implications for the Republican Party and its future direction.
